scope: One installed WSL2 local SDK-unavailability-to-CLI execution fallback, followed by complete regular-PR delivery, merged-artifact behavior verification, known accounting and exact terminal resource absence. limitations: The SDK adapter was genuinely incompatible with the selected authentic CLI version before worker launch. This does not qualify fallback after an SDK worker has started or a provider stream has been interrupted.
No historical scheduler input or durable SDK-rejection receipt is fabricated. Explicit regular delivery and SDK-first execution fallback are separate facts.
